subject: Generator is now openai:gpt-6-luna (Nathan); E4 prereg and commands name sonnet
body: Nathan changed the research agent / generator from claude-cli:sonnet to openai:gpt-6-luna (OpenAIResponsesLLM; price 0.10/0.50 per M tokens is in llm.PRICES_PER_MTOK, unverified; bills against the OpenAI credits, where claude-cli was free). Your side: results/prereg/E4.json, scripts/e4_commands.py and any --generator sonnet defaults need the new spec, and E4 cost estimates need the generator priced. Three effects on the loop: (1) the OpenAI backend sends no temperature, so the generator's temperature=1.0 is dropped and variety comes only from the variation seed in the prompt; watch for near-duplicate environments. (2) I7: the generator now shares a family with held-out judge J2 (gpt-5.1) and the GPT-5 target; measure.py warns about this in final mode, and PLAN 4.4 records it as a waiver with Haiku as the check. (3) generate() wording changed in 308e3e7 (no 'for a study of model behaviour'), so environments from earlier dry runs are not comparable. Abhi is updating configs/models.json.
